label: Exploratory V5 C4 with paid second-actor Opening Weave candidate H2
assumptions: This is not nimble-knots-artillery-v5 and has no runtime, replay, protocol, reward, UI, or asset authority.
It retains Candidate C4's ideal-direct-hit range/damage values, forward-only Needlepoint Seam Pin, and equal non-refilling 128-unit Escape Slack reserve.

Only the actor assigned the second normal turn starts with one public Opening Weave. When hit by the first actor's opening direct cast, its owner may accept normal damage or spend 64 existing Escape Slack to absorb that one hit; the Weave is then consumed.

The experiment's transparent counter policy spends the Weave only against 45-or-more damage (Threadball or Spoolburst). A player-facing rule would remain an explicit choice; the bounded forced-opening search evaluates both accepting and spending whenever legal.
If unused, the Opening Weave expires when its owner completes that owner's first normal action. It cannot be refilled, held after that response opportunity, stacked, or used as a later combat shield.
Fire still ends the caster's turn. Terrain, aim, splash, animation, UI, and production counter-effects remain excluded.
